reports.title: Richard Jones
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: we are now updating leaflet 2-7-2 of the Department's medical policy document (Joint Service Publication (JSP) 950) which covers the provision and management of Defence mental health services. This will include new guidance and policy on the principles of transfer, which will include addressing both internal transfers of care between different Defence Medical Services (DMS) care providers and the transfers between DMS providers and external agencies.
promises.summary: Update leaflet 2-7-2 of JSP 950 to clarify transfer principles and responsibilities

concerns.quote: During the course of the Inquest | had cause to hear evidence from a number of witnesses involved in the care of Richard, a serving member of the Armed Forces, when he complained of auditory hallucinations, persecutory delusions, low mood, disrupted sleep and poor concentration.
concerns.hazard: lack of appropriate mental health assessment and follow-up

concerns.quote: can make a Regulation 28 report if he or she has concerns with a view to the prevention of future deaths
concerns.hazard: absence of systematic review of referral and care pathways

concerns.quote: a) As to the way in which information obtained from such a patient is recorded , with especial reference to the perceived level of risk and the degree of urgency in carrying out an assessment.
b) As to how that information is shared with other agencies involved in the care of that patient to ensure that it is accurately passed on, particularly as to the level of risk and degree of urgency.
c) As to who has primary responsibility for the care of that patient and how that is recorded by all those involved, particularly where there is a transfer of care.

reports.title: Charlie Owen: Prevention of Future Deaths Report

concerns.quote: army VRM guidance does not invite those attending case conferences to consider 'checking in' or meeting those assessed as posing a risk of self-harm on return to their unit
concerns.hazard: risk of self-harm on return to unit

concerns.quote: suicide prevention training is not mandatory for army welfare officers/welfare NCOs
concerns.hazard: insufficient suicide prevention training for welfare officers

concerns.quote: insufficient focus in that training on the actual aim including reducing risk and preventing suicide
concerns.hazard: insufficient focus on reducing risk and preventing suicide in VRM training

concerns.quote: information sharing between medical and command personnel poses challenges
lack of detail contained within the case conference notes hindered this inquest's ability to establish precisely what risk information was shared
concerns.hazard: lack of detail in case conference notes

concerns.quote: information contained about relevant protective factors and safety actions is not necessarily shared with the Chain of Command
concerns.hazard: information not shared with Chain of Command

links.explanation: Both reports highlight problems with sharing and documenting risk-related information about armed forces personnel with mental health needs. The earlier report focuses on inter‑agency transmission of risk details, while the later report notes insufficient detail in case conference notes and VRM process documentation.
